sunset-point-kasauli.name: Sunset Point Kasauli
sunset-point-kasauli.history_tagline: Kasauli's evening viewpoint over the Solan valley and lower Shivaliks.
sunset-point-kasauli.what_you_find: A railed promenade above the pine slopes where visitors gather for sunset over the Shivalik foothills, with snack stalls and a short walk from Kasauli's Mall.

cholling-monastery.name: Cholling Monastery
cholling-monastery.history_tagline: Guru Ghantal-era Buddhist monastery above the Chandrabhaga confluence, Lahaul.
cholling-monastery.what_you_find: A quiet Drukpa Kagyu monastery on a ridge above Tandi, with old murals and views down to the Chandra-Bhaga river meeting.

trilokinath-temple.name: Trilokinath Temple
trilokinath-temple.history_tagline: Shared Hindu-Buddhist shrine in Lahaul's Chandrabhaga valley.
trilokinath-temple.what_you_find: A white marble shrine worshipped as both a Shiva temple and an Avalokiteshvara site, one of the few genuinely shared Hindu-Buddhist pilgrimage spots in the Himalayas.

tauni-devi-temple.name: Tauni Devi Temple
tauni-devi-temple.history_tagline: Wood-carved Shakti shrine in Hamirpur district.
tauni-devi-temple.what_you_find: A pagoda-style hill temple known for its wood carving and a small annual fair, off the usual Hamirpur tourist track.

tarna-devi-temple.name: Tarna Devi Temple
tarna-devi-temple.history_tagline: Shyama Kali shrine atop Tarna Hill — 305 steps above Mandi's bazaar.
tarna-devi-temple.what_you_find: A hilltop Kali shrine reached by a long staircase from Mandi town, with panoramic views over the Beas and the bazaar below.

tara-devi-temple.name: Tara Devi Temple
tara-devi-temple.history_tagline: Hilltop Shakti temple 13km from Shimla, above the NH5 — panoramic valley views.
tara-devi-temple.what_you_find: A forested hilltop shrine just off the Shimla-Kalka highway, popular for a short detour with wide views of the surrounding ridges.

sundernagar-lake.name: Sundernagar Lake
sundernagar-lake.history_tagline: Man-made lake feeding the Beas-Sutlej hydel project — migratory birds in winter.
sundernagar-lake.what_you_find: A calm reservoir on the edge of Sundernagar town, popular with local walkers and, in winter, migratory waterfowl.

st-johns-church.name: St. John's Church
st-johns-church.history_tagline: Colonial-era church in Dalhousie's Moti Tiba — Gothic stonework amid deodars.
st-johns-church.what_you_find: A stone Gothic-style church set among deodar trees on Moti Tiba hill, one of Dalhousie's cluster of colonial-era churches.

st-francis-church.name: St. Francis Church
st-francis-church.history_tagline: 1894 Catholic church near Subhash Chowk, Dalhousie — Belgian stained glass.
st-francis-church.what_you_find: A red-brick Catholic church near Dalhousie's main chowk, notable for its stained glass brought from Belgium.

vyas-cave.name: Vyas Cave
vyas-cave.history_tagline: Riverside cave in Bilaspur where sage Vyas is said to have meditated.
vyas-cave.what_you_find: A small cave shrine on the banks of the Sutlej near Bilaspur, associated with the sage Vyas and linked to the submerged old Bilaspur town.

shikari-devi-temple.name: Shikari Devi Temple
shikari-devi-temple.history_tagline: Roofless shrine at 3,332m near Janjehli — snowbound most of the year.
shikari-devi-temple.what_you_find: An open-roofed shrine on a high ridge above Janjehli, reachable by trek or jeep track, with sweeping views across the Dhauladhar and Pir Panjal.

roghi-village.name: Roghi Village
roghi-village.history_tagline: Cliffside Kinnauri hamlet above Kalpa — the notorious 'Suicide Point' drive.
roghi-village.what_you_find: A small Kinnauri village on a sheer cliff edge above the Satluj gorge, known locally for its dramatic drop-off viewpoint near Kalpa.

rewalsar-lake.name: Rewalsar Lake
rewalsar-lake.history_tagline: Sacred floating-reed lake shared by Hindus, Buddhists and Sikhs, near Mandi.
rewalsar-lake.what_you_find: A small hill lake ringed by monasteries, a Sikh gurudwara and Lomas Rishi cave, with floating reed islands considered sacred by three faiths.

renuka-temple.name: Renuka Temple
renuka-temple.history_tagline: Parshuram temple on the banks of Renuka Lake — Sirmaur's biggest fair each November.
renuka-temple.what_you_find: A lakeside Parshuram-Renuka shrine that draws Sirmaur's largest annual fair each November, alongside the adjoining Renuka zoo and lake walk.

norbulingka-institute.name: Norbulingka Institute
norbulingka-institute.history_tagline: Tibetan arts institute near Dharamshala — thangka painting, woodcarving, gardens.
norbulingka-institute.what_you_find: A landscaped campus at Sidhpur teaching traditional Tibetan thangka painting, woodcarving and statue-making, with a temple, gardens and a doll museum.

nicholas-roerich-art-gallery.name: Nicholas Roerich Art Gallery
nicholas-roerich-art-gallery.history_tagline: Painter's estate-turned-museum in Naggar, overlooking the Kullu valley.
nicholas-roerich-art-gallery.what_you_find: The Russian painter's former home and studio in Naggar, now a gallery of his Himalayan paintings, set in an orchard with valley views.

mud-village.name: Mud Village
mud-village.history_tagline: Remote trailhead hamlet deep in Spiti's Pin Valley.
mud-village.what_you_find: The last inhabited village in the Pin Valley, used as a base for treks into Pin Valley National Park and homestays with local Spitian families.

moorang.name: Moorang
moorang.history_tagline: Apple-orchard village on the Sangla-Spiti road in Kinnaur.
moorang.what_you_find: A terraced apple- and chilgoza-growing village along the road from Sangla toward Spiti, largely untouched by mainstream tourism.

lalung-monastery.name: Lalung Monastery
lalung-monastery.history_tagline: Centuries-old Spiti monastery near Rangrik, off the tourist trail.
lalung-monastery.what_you_find: A small, rarely-visited Spiti monastery with old wall paintings, reached via a side road off the main Kaza highway.

lakshmi-narayan-temple.name: Lakshmi Narayan Temple
lakshmi-narayan-temple.history_tagline: 10th-century shikhara temple complex in the heart of Chamba town.
lakshmi-narayan-temple.what_you_find: A cluster of six shikhara-style stone temples in Chamba town's old quarter, among the oldest surviving temple complexes in the state.

kutlehar-fort-ruins.name: Kutlehar Fort Ruins
kutlehar-fort-ruins.history_tagline: Hilltop fort ruins of the old Kutlehar princely state, Una district.
kutlehar-fort-ruins.what_you_find: Crumbling ramparts of a minor hill-state fort, largely unmarked and rarely visited, on a ridge in Una district.

kullu.name: Kullu
kullu.history_tagline: Valley of Gods — Dussehra hub on the Beas, gateway to Manali and Parvati.
kullu.what_you_find: Kullu's riverside town, famous for its week-long Dussehra festival, shawl and handicraft markets, and as the road junction toward Manali and the Parvati valley.

kufri-fun-world.name: Kufri Fun World
kufri-fun-world.history_tagline: Amusement and go-kart park in Kufri, near Shimla.
kufri-fun-world.what_you_find: A hillside amusement park near Kufri with go-karting, rides and a small zoo — a popular family stop on the Shimla-Kufri drive.

koldam-dam.name: Koldam Dam
koldam-dam.history_tagline: Hydel reservoir on the Sutlej near Bilaspur.
koldam-dam.what_you_find: A large Sutlej hydel reservoir with viewpoints along the highway, part of the Koldam hydro project near Bilaspur.

kiarighat.name: Kiarighat
kiarighat.history_tagline: Forested viewpoint on the old Shimla-Kalka highway.
kiarighat.what_you_find: A roadside forest stop on the old cart-road route between Shimla and Kalka, with pine cover and a small dhaba culture.

keylong.name: Keylong
keylong.history_tagline: Lahaul & Spiti's district HQ on the Manali-Leh highway.
keylong.what_you_find: The administrative headquarters of Lahaul & Spiti, a common overnight stop on the Manali-Leh highway with monasteries visible across the valley.

kamru-fort.name: Kamru Fort
kamru-fort.history_tagline: Ancient Bashahr capital's tower-fort above Sangla — built by the Pandavas, legend says.
kamru-fort.what_you_find: A wooden tower-fort above Kamru village, the ancient capital of the Bashahr kingdom, with a Kamakhya shrine inside.

kamlah-fort.name: Kamlah Fort
kamlah-fort.history_tagline: 17th-century hill fort of the Mandi kings, deep in rural Mandi district.
kamlah-fort.what_you_find: A 17th-century Mandi-kingdom hill fort on the Sikandar Dhar ridge, reached by a trek through remote villages.

kali-bari-temple.name: Kali Bari Temple
kali-bari-temple.history_tagline: 1845 Kali shrine on Bantony Hill, Shimla — the city's namesake goddess.
kali-bari-temple.what_you_find: A Bengali-founded Kali shrine on Bantony Hill in central Shimla, dedicated to the Shyamala form of Kali from which the city takes its name.

jogini-waterfall.name: Jogini Waterfall
jogini-waterfall.history_tagline: Short hike from Vashisht to a cascading Himalayan waterfall near Manali.
jogini-waterfall.what_you_find: A multi-tiered waterfall reached by an easy hour's walk above Vashisht village, a popular short trek near Manali.

joginder-nagar.name: Joginder Nagar
joginder-nagar.history_tagline: Mandi-district town famous for its narrow-gauge Kangra Valley Railway hydel line.
joginder-nagar.what_you_find: A Mandi-district town known for its century-old hydel power scheme and as one terminus of the narrow-gauge Kangra Valley Railway.

jatoli-shiv-temple.name: Jatoli Shiv Temple
jatoli-shiv-temple.history_tagline: Asia's tallest Shiva temple, near Solan.
jatoli-shiv-temple.what_you_find: A towering South Indian-style Shiva temple near Solan, claimed to be Asia's tallest of its kind, built over decades by a single sadhu.

jangi-village.name: Jangi Village
jangi-village.history_tagline: Kinnauri village on the road toward Spiti, past Nako.
jangi-village.what_you_find: A cliffside Kinnauri village along the Spiti road, with terraced fields and traditional stone-and-timber houses.

jakhu-temple.name: Jakhu Temple
jakhu-temple.history_tagline: Hilltop Hanuman shrine above Shimla, marked by a 108-foot statue.
jakhu-temple.what_you_find: Shimla's highest point, topped by a giant Hanuman statue visible across the town, with resident monkeys along the approach path.

jakhu-ropeway.name: Jakhu Ropeway
jakhu-ropeway.history_tagline: Cable car linking Shimla's Ridge to Jakhu Hill.
jakhu-ropeway.what_you_find: A short cable-car ride from near the Ridge up to Jakhu Temple, an easier alternative to the uphill walk.

jaitak-fort.name: Jaitak Fort
jaitak-fort.history_tagline: Gorkha War-era hill fort near Nahan, Sirmaur.
jaitak-fort.what_you_find: A ruined hill fort near Nahan, site of a key battle in the Anglo-Gorkha War, now a quiet forested ruin.

jagatsukh.name: Jagatsukh
jagatsukh.history_tagline: Ancient former capital of Kullu, with two of the valley's oldest stone temples.
jagatsukh.what_you_find: The original capital of the Kullu kingdom before Naggar, home to two of the valley's oldest surviving stone shikhara temples.

hatu-peak.name: Hatu Peak
hatu-peak.history_tagline: 3,400m viewpoint above Narkanda with a small Mata temple at the summit.
hatu-peak.what_you_find: A 360-degree summit viewpoint above Narkanda with a small Hatu Mata temple, reachable by an easy hike or jeep track.

haripurdhar-temple.name: Haripurdhar Temple
haripurdhar-temple.history_tagline: Remote Bhangayani Devi shrine deep in Sirmaur's hills.
haripurdhar-temple.what_you_find: A remote ridge-top Bhangayani Devi temple deep in Sirmaur, reached by a long forested drive, with wide Himalayan views.

hampta-pass-trek-start.name: Hampta Pass (trailhead)
hampta-pass-trek-start.history_tagline: Start point for the classic Kullu-to-Lahaul crossover trek.
hampta-pass-trek-start.what_you_find: The Kullu-side trailhead for the Hampta Pass trek, which crosses into Lahaul's stark landscape near Chandratal.

green-valley.name: Green Valley Manali
green-valley.history_tagline: Riverside meadow viewpoint on the outskirts of Manali.
green-valley.what_you_find: An open riverside meadow on Manali's outskirts, popular for photos and short walks along the Beas.

gondhla-fort.name: Gondhla Fort
gondhla-fort.history_tagline: Nine-storey mud-and-timber fort of the Lahaul thakurs.
gondhla-fort.what_you_find: A nine-storey mud-and-timber fort-house of the old Lahaul thakur family, on the Manali-Keylong road.

ganji-pahari.name: Ganji Pahari
ganji-pahari.history_tagline: Bare-ridge viewpoint above Kasauli, popular for sunrise treks.
ganji-pahari.what_you_find: A bare, grassy ridge above Kasauli reached by a short trek, popular at sunrise for views across the Shivaliks toward the plains.

dehnasar-lake-trek.name: Dehnasar Lake Trek
dehnasar-lake-trek.history_tagline: High-altitude lake trek in the Chamba-Bharmour hills.
dehnasar-lake-trek.what_you_find: A high-altitude alpine lake reached by trek in the hills above Bharmour, less crowded than the nearby Manimahesh route.

darcha.name: Darcha
darcha.history_tagline: Last Lahaul village on the Manali-Leh highway — trailhead for several treks.
darcha.what_you_find: The last village on the Lahaul side of the Manali-Leh highway, a checkpoint and trailhead for treks into Zanskar and the Shingo La.

dal-lake-dharamshala.name: Dal Lake Dharamshala
dal-lake-dharamshala.history_tagline: Small deodar-ringed lake near Naddi, above McLeod Ganj.
dal-lake-dharamshala.what_you_find: A small, deodar-ringed lake near Naddi above McLeod Ganj, with a lakeside temple and an annual fair.

dainkund-peak.name: Dainkund Peak
dainkund-peak.history_tagline: Dalhousie's highest point — the 'singing hill', for its wind through pines.
dainkund-peak.what_you_find: Dalhousie's highest point, nicknamed the 'singing hill' for the wind through its pines, with a short forested trek to the summit.

christ-church.name: Christ Church
christ-church.history_tagline: 1857 neo-Gothic church on Shimla's Ridge, the state's oldest church.
christ-church.what_you_find: Himachal's oldest church, a neo-Gothic landmark on Shimla's Ridge with stained-glass windows depicting Christian virtues.

chindi-mata-temple.name: Chindi Mata Temple
chindi-mata-temple.history_tagline: Multi-tiered wood-carved temple in Karsog valley's Chindi village.
chindi-mata-temple.what_you_find: A multi-storey wood-carved temple in the Chindi village of Karsog valley, with carved wooden animal motifs and a stepped well nearby.

chicham-bridge.name: Chicham Bridge
chicham-bridge.history_tagline: Asia's highest suspension bridge, linking Kibber and Chicham in Spiti.
chicham-bridge.what_you_find: A dramatic suspension bridge spanning a deep gorge between Kibber and Chicham villages, billed as Asia's highest of its kind.

bon-monastery-near-solan.name: Bon Monastery, Solan
bon-monastery-near-solan.history_tagline: One of the world's oldest Bon monasteries, on a hilltop above Solan town.
bon-monastery-near-solan.what_you_find: A pre-Buddhist Bon-tradition monastery on a hill above Solan, a rare site for this older Tibetan faith outside Lahaul-Spiti.

bhuri-singh-museum.name: Bhuri Singh Museum
bhuri-singh-museum.history_tagline: Chamba town museum of Pahari miniature paintings and hill-state artefacts.
bhuri-singh-museum.what_you_find: A century-old museum in Chamba town holding Pahari miniature paintings, coins, and artefacts from the old hill states.

bhuntar.name: Bhuntar
bhuntar.history_tagline: Kullu valley's airport town, at the Beas-Parvati confluence.
bhuntar.what_you_find: The Kullu valley's airport town, sitting at the confluence of the Beas and Parvati rivers, a common transit stop for Manikaran and Manali traffic.

bhrigu-lake-trek.name: Bhrigu Lake Trek
bhrigu-lake-trek.history_tagline: Popular high-altitude lake trek above Gulaba, near Manali.
bhrigu-lake-trek.what_you_find: A high-altitude alpine lake reached by a 2-3 day trek above Gulaba, one of the most popular short treks near Manali.

bhagsunag-waterfall-mcleodganj.name: Bhagsunag Waterfall
bhagsunag-waterfall-mcleodganj.history_tagline: Short walk above Bhagsu village, McLeod Ganj — temple and falls together.
bhagsunag-waterfall-mcleodganj.what_you_find: A short, popular walk above Bhagsu village near McLeod Ganj, combining an old Shiva temple with a cascading waterfall.
